title: Release version 0.4.0
body:
Minor version bump from 0.3.3 to 0.4.0 across the monorepo.

## Changes

- **Version Updates**: Bumped all 7 fixed packages to 0.4.0
  - @objectstack/spec
  - @objectstack/client  
  - @objectstack/driver-memory
  - @objectstack/objectql
  - @objectstack/plugin-hono-server
  - @objectstack/runtime
  - @objectstack/types

- **CHANGELOG**: Added 0.4.0 release entries for all packages

- **Root Package**: Updated monorepo version to match

## Notes

Packages in the fixed group maintain version parity per changeset configuration. Dependencies using `workspace:*` will resolve to the new version automatically.
